items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I like Zoot a lot too, Zoot Sims. Lucky Thompson.

ctx.x: Well someone, I think Scott Yanow, who’s a pretty good writer, he said that your tenor mixes Don Byas and Paul Gonzalves.

Yeah. Well see my first inclination is to bristle and say oh how does he know? But it is a compliment and I appreciate that. And those two people, I take that as a compliment because I love both of them. And I guess I could understand where he’s coming from because they were an influence on me. I love both of them and I love a softer kind of a tenor sound anyway. I’m not a loud player, I just don’t do that. I like Zoot a lot too, Zoot Sims. Lucky Thompson. So that kind of thing, it’s like thanks, but again I’m…
You’ve done some recording with Randy Sandke, right?
